description.from:
The order in which the initiative PPY-25ffa3 ships, as releasable milestones. Each child task is one milestone with entry and exit criteria, what is customer-visible, and the index deploys it contains. The full table is in the comment on PPY-25ffa3 and in docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md.

Earliest milestone at which Threat Intelligence can run on the shared stack: M5 (needs M3 isolation enforced, M4 shared serving and site as data, and the brand-neutral acceptance test PPY-7e396d).
First outside paying tenant: M8.
